cube_briggs_diagnosis.method: CASA's per-row IMAGING_WEIGHT scratch table, captured by wrapping PySynthesisImager.makePSF around an unchanged casatasks.tclean (point-cube-briggs request, niter=0), against an evidence-only native dump of every (MAIN row, channel) imaging weight (patch evidence-weight-dump.patch, never committed).
cube_briggs_diagnosis.before_fix: 7 of 3,056,967 weights differ (channels 1, 4 twice, 6, 10, 12, 15; 0.2% to 32%); every other weight agrees to 1.4e-7. All 7 have a native Float u-cell coordinate exactly at k + 1/2.
cube_briggs_diagnosis.cause: Native evaluated the cube rule with u mirrored relative to BriggsCubeWeightor (which negates u and v, FTMachine::negateUV and u = -uvw*f). Mirrored grids agree for interior samples, but rounding half away from zero is not mirror-symmetric at an exact Float tie.
cube_briggs_diagnosis.rejected_hypothesis: Fused multiply-add contraction in CASA's arm64 build: a native mul_add experiment changed only one of the seven, and row 32452 shows CASA rounds the unfused tie.
cube_briggs_diagnosis.after_fix: 0 of 3,056,967 weights differ; worst relative difference per channel <= 1.35e-7.
cube_briggs_diagnosis.regression: crates/casa-imaging-operator/tests/weighting.rs a_float_tie_rounds_in_casas_orientation fails on the parent and passes at 2628d8b.

empty_plane_probe.source: SIImageStore::divideImageByWeightVal (CASA 6.7.6.14 9c42dc1): a plane is divided by its Float .sumwt only above 1e-07, else set to zero
empty_plane_probe.fixture: refim_point_withline.ms copy with WEIGHT_SPECTRUM from initweights; native channels 4-6 scaled so image channels 5 and 6 reach sumwt 1.194e-8, channels 11-13 so channel 12 reaches 9.55e-7; standard cube, natural, niter 20
empty_plane_probe.before_fix: at 2628d8b CASA zeroes channels 5 and 6 (PSF, residual, image, model), native images them (PSF peak 1, residual 0.418, image 1.20, model 0.78); channel 12 and channel 0 (sumwt 0) agree
empty_plane_probe.after_fix: at 8fcee92 channels 5 and 6 are zero in every product as in CASA; worst per-channel NRMS over the cube: psf 1.94e-5, residual 1.94e-5, image 9.5e-6, model 2.1e-7. The two boundary channels 4 and 11, which interpolate between an ordinary and a 1e-13-scaled weight, differ in sumwt by 3.1e-5 and 6.0e-5 relative: precision amplification of this constructed 10^13 weight step, not a T1.5 row
empty_plane_probe.regression: crates/casars-imager/tests/t1/cube.rs a_plane_at_casas_empty_sum_weight_bound_is_empty fails on the parent validity and passes at 8fcee92; normal_state.rs pins the Float comparison

moving_field_oracles: At 8b0fe44 + 855abcc on the Mac mini with CASA_RS_TESTDATA_ROOT=/Volumes/home/casatestdata: t41 moving_field_mfs_envelope_matches_casa_field_origin_direction gives CASA's MFS increment 125020996.11132812 Hz exactly (relative 0) and t41_trackfield_phase_centre_matches_casa_at_three_row_times passes; the cubesource oracle needs separately frozen CASA products and was not run.
independent_review: A fresh-context Claude reviewer (supplementary; the repository's required Astra review is unavailable in this environment and remains pending) found nothing blocking in 3016f1b, 2628d8b and 7b25e63; its follow-ups (envelope first-time cost, survey scan law, docs) are in 8b0fe44. Noted: the orientation fix also corrects the outermost u column on odd widths, and main's intent state ranges expand without bound.
